student_notice: These descriptions and explanations are proposed guidance content for review. They are not admission decisions or psychometric diagnoses.

riasec_explanations.R: You may enjoy practical activities that involve tools, equipment, movement, or producing visible results.
riasec_explanations.I: You may enjoy exploring questions, analysing information, solving problems, and understanding how things work.
riasec_explanations.A: You may enjoy creating, expressing ideas, designing, writing, performing, or working in less structured ways.
riasec_explanations.S: You may enjoy helping, teaching, supporting, communicating with, or contributing to other people.
riasec_explanations.E: You may enjoy leading, persuading, organising initiatives, making decisions, or developing opportunities.
riasec_explanations.C: You may enjoy organising information, following clear procedures, checking details, and maintaining accurate records.

common_requirements: Meet the general admission requirements published by TCC for the applicable academic year.
Submit the records requested by the TCC registrar or admissions office.
Complete any programme-specific screening that TCC formally adopts and publishes.

bs-information-technology.description: Focuses on applying computing, software, data, and network technologies to organisational needs.

learning_area_descriptions.Software development: Design, build, test, and maintain software applications using programming concepts and development tools.
learning_area_descriptions.Information management: Organise, store, retrieve, and protect information using databases and structured data practices.
learning_area_descriptions.Computer networks: Set up, manage, secure, and troubleshoot the systems that connect computers and digital services.
learning_area_descriptions.Systems analysis: Study organisational needs and workflows, gather requirements, and design appropriate technology solutions.

bs-information-technology.strand_guidance: STEM supports mathematics and analytical preparation, while TVL-ICT provides practical exposure to computer systems and digital tools.
bs-information-technology.readiness_prompt: Discuss your interest in problem solving, technology, detail-oriented work, and continuous learning.

bs-business-administration.description: Focuses on managing organisations, people, operations, markets, and business information.

learning_area_descriptions.Management: Develop skills in planning, organising, leading teams, and evaluating organisational performance.
learning_area_descriptions.Marketing: Understand customer needs, market research, product positioning, promotion, and relationship building.
learning_area_descriptions.Finance fundamentals: Learn budgeting, financial statements, cash-flow concepts, and responsible business decision-making.
learning_area_descriptions.Business operations: Examine the processes, resources, quality controls, and services needed to run an organisation effectively.

bs-business-administration.strand_guidance: ABM offers the closest preparation in business, accounting, management, and entrepreneurship; GAS also provides broad academic preparation.
bs-business-administration.readiness_prompt: Discuss your interest in leadership, communication, planning, and working with business information.

bs-criminology.description: Focuses on crime, public safety, justice systems, investigation, and community-based prevention.

learning_area_descriptions.Criminal justice: Study how law enforcement, courts, corrections, and related institutions respond to crime and protect rights.
learning_area_descriptions.Law-enforcement foundations: Build knowledge of professional ethics, legal procedures, public service, and responsible community relations.
learning_area_descriptions.Investigation: Develop foundational skills in observation, interviewing, evidence handling, documentation, and analytical reporting.
learning_area_descriptions.Community safety: Examine crime prevention, risk reduction, public-safety planning, and cooperation with local communities.

bs-criminology.strand_guidance: HUMSS supports study of society, governance, communication, and human behaviour, while GAS offers broad preparation across disciplines.
bs-criminology.readiness_prompt: Ask TCC about current fitness, conduct, health, or other programme requirements before making a decision.

bs-hospitality-management.description: Focuses on guest service, hospitality operations, events, food service, and tourism-related management.

learning_area_descriptions.Guest service: Practise professional communication, service recovery, and creating positive experiences for diverse guests.
learning_area_descriptions.Hospitality operations: Learn how lodging, front-office, housekeeping, reservations, and service teams work together.
learning_area_descriptions.Events: Plan and coordinate event concepts, schedules, venues, suppliers, guests, and on-site operations.
learning_area_descriptions.Food-service management: Study food-service workflows, sanitation, menu planning, cost control, and customer service.

bs-hospitality-management.strand_guidance: TVL-Home Economics can provide practical hospitality and food-service exposure, while ABM supports the management side of hospitality operations.
bs-hospitality-management.readiness_prompt: Discuss your interest in service, teamwork, communication, and working in active operational settings.

bachelor-elementary-education.description: Prepares learners for teaching and supporting children across elementary learning areas.

learning_area_descriptions.Teaching methods: Plan age-appropriate lessons and use varied strategies to help elementary learners understand different subjects.
learning_area_descriptions.Child development: Understand how children grow, learn, communicate, and develop socially, emotionally, physically, and cognitively.
learning_area_descriptions.Classroom assessment: Create and interpret activities, observations, and assessments that guide instruction and learner support.
learning_area_descriptions.Learning resources: Select, design, and adapt print, digital, and hands-on materials for inclusive elementary classrooms.

bachelor-elementary-education.strand_guidance: HUMSS develops communication and understanding of people and society; GAS provides broad preparation across subjects taught in elementary school.
bachelor-elementary-education.readiness_prompt: Discuss your interest in teaching children, communication, patience, and responsible classroom practice.

bachelor-secondary-education.description: Prepares learners for secondary teaching, including the currently recorded English, Filipino, and Social Studies or Araling Panlipunan majors.

learning_area_descriptions.Teaching methods: Design lessons, discussions, and learning activities suited to junior and senior high school classrooms.
learning_area_descriptions.Adolescent learning: Study the cognitive, social, emotional, and developmental needs that influence how adolescents learn.
learning_area_descriptions.Subject specialisation: Build deeper content and teaching knowledge in the selected English, Filipino, or Social Studies major.
learning_area_descriptions.Classroom assessment: Develop fair assessments, interpret learner performance, and use feedback to improve secondary instruction.

bachelor-secondary-education.strand_guidance: HUMSS aligns closely with the recorded English, Filipino, and Social Studies majors; GAS offers broad preparation for further subject specialisation.
bachelor-secondary-education.readiness_prompt: Confirm the available major with TCC and discuss your interest in teaching, communication, and subject-focused study.

bs-midwifery.description: Focuses on maternal and newborn care, community health, professional practice, and supervised clinical learning.

learning_area_descriptions.Maternal care: Study health support before, during, and after childbirth, including monitoring, education, and appropriate referral.
learning_area_descriptions.Newborn care: Learn essential newborn assessment, routine care, parent education, and recognition of conditions needing referral.
learning_area_descriptions.Community health: Understand preventive care, health promotion, family support, and maternal-newborn services in community settings.
learning_area_descriptions.Clinical practice: Apply knowledge and professional standards through supervised skills training and clinical learning experiences.

bs-midwifery.strand_guidance: STEM strengthens preparation in the sciences, while relevant TVL-Home Economics health-care subjects may provide practical care experience.
bs-midwifery.readiness_prompt: Ask TCC about current health, clinical placement, equipment, and regulatory requirements before making a decision.

bachelor-library-information-science.description: Focuses on organising, preserving, finding, and providing access to information and knowledge resources.

learning_area_descriptions.Information organisation: Describe, classify, index, and arrange information so people can discover and retrieve it efficiently.
learning_area_descriptions.Reference services: Identify information needs, evaluate sources, conduct searches, and guide users toward reliable resources.
learning_area_descriptions.Digital libraries: Work with digital collections, repositories, metadata, access systems, and long-term digital preservation.
learning_area_descriptions.Records and collections: Develop, preserve, and manage physical or digital records and collections throughout their useful life.

bachelor-library-information-science.strand_guidance: HUMSS supports research and communication, while TVL-ICT can help with digital information systems and technology-enabled library services.
bachelor-library-information-science.readiness_prompt: Discuss your interest in information, service, technology, organisation, and careful record keeping.

bs-sociology.description: Focuses on society, communities, institutions, culture, social research, and social change.

learning_area_descriptions.Social theory: Use major sociological ideas to understand relationships, institutions, inequality, culture, and social change.
learning_area_descriptions.Research methods: Design ethical studies and collect, organise, analyse, and interpret qualitative and quantitative social data.
learning_area_descriptions.Community studies: Examine how communities are formed, how they change, and how local institutions shape everyday life.
learning_area_descriptions.Social analysis: Evaluate social issues using evidence, multiple perspectives, and clear written or oral communication.

bs-sociology.strand_guidance: HUMSS provides close preparation in society, culture, communication, and social sciences; GAS offers a broad academic foundation.
bs-sociology.readiness_prompt: Discuss your interest in people, communities, research, writing, and analysing social issues.

bs-community-development.description: Focuses on participatory community work, programme planning, local development, and social mobilisation.

learning_area_descriptions.Community organising: Build relationships, support local leadership, facilitate participation, and help communities act on shared concerns.
learning_area_descriptions.Development planning: Assess community needs and resources, set priorities, and design inclusive strategies for local development.
learning_area_descriptions.Project work: Plan, coordinate, monitor, document, and evaluate community-based programmes and services.
learning_area_descriptions.Participatory research: Work with community members to gather evidence, interpret local conditions, and shape practical responses.

bs-community-development.strand_guidance: HUMSS supports communication, social analysis, and understanding communities; GAS provides flexible preparation for interdisciplinary community work.
bs-community-development.readiness_prompt: Discuss your interest in community service, facilitation, fieldwork, teamwork, and project planning.

bachelor-physical-education.description: Prepares learners to teach and facilitate physical activity, movement, fitness, sports, and wellness education.

learning_area_descriptions.Movement education: Understand movement concepts and design safe activities that develop coordination, body awareness, and physical literacy.
learning_area_descriptions.Fitness: Learn principles of exercise, conditioning, wellness, and age-appropriate fitness assessment and programme planning.
learning_area_descriptions.Sports instruction: Teach sport skills, rules, teamwork, safety, officiating, and responsible participation in physical activities.
learning_area_descriptions.Teaching methods: Plan inclusive physical education lessons, manage active learning environments, and assess learner progress.

bachelor-physical-education.strand_guidance: The Sports Track offers the closest activity-based preparation, while HUMSS and GAS support communication and broad academic readiness for teaching.
bachelor-physical-education.readiness_prompt: Ask TCC about current physical, health, practicum, or activity requirements before making a decision.
